shortDescription: Catcher Predict said the Chicago White Sox option in Polymarket’s Chicago White Sox vs. Cleveland Guardians market fell sharply from 43.5% an hour earlier to 19.5%, a 24% drop. According to ChainCatcher, the move reflects a sudden swing in the prediction market and may be affected by breaking news.
